info.title: JLPT Practice & Tutor API
info.description: Stateless JLPT practice and tutor API powered by FastAPI, Pydantic, and langchain-ollama (ChatOllama) with strict privacy guarantees.

get.description: Lightweight health check that never invokes Ollama or external network calls.

post.description: Generate unofficial AI-labeled JLPT vocabulary, grammar, or reading questions in one batch call.
Generate one original follow-up question targeting the same learning point with Cache-Control: no-store.
Generate a single JLPT practice question with Cache-Control: no-store.
Generate a single JLPT practice question with Cache-Control: no-store.
Evaluate a submitted JLPT multiple-choice answer locally without calling Ollama.
Evaluate a submitted JLPT multiple-choice answer locally without calling Ollama.
Answer questions about the selected practice item using a bounded recent conversation window.
Stateless JLPT tutor endpoint. Context stays only in browser & request-local memory.
Stateless JLPT tutor endpoint. Context stays only in browser & request-local memory.
Explain word meanings, original examples, verified past-exam examples, and nuances without saving content.

413.description: Request body exceeds configured byte limit.

502.description: Malformed model output or model generation failure.

AlternativeExplanation.title: AlternativeExplanation
AlternativeExplanation.description: Explanation for why a distractor option does not fit.

AnswerEvaluationRequest.title: AnswerEvaluationRequest
AnswerEvaluationRequest.description: Request payload for deterministic, non-LLM multiple-choice answer evaluation.

scoring_notice.title: Scoring Notice
scoring_notice.default: Self-study mode: The answer key is held in browser memory and compared locally without calling the Ollama model or storing scores. Because a browser-held answer key is inspectable, this scoring is for self-study feedback only, is not tamper-proof, and does not predict an official JLPT score.

score_disclaimer.title: Score Disclaimer
score_disclaimer.default: Unofficial AI practice with approximate difficulty: practice accuracy is for self-study only and does not predict or guarantee an official JLPT score.

AnswerEvaluationResponse.title: AnswerEvaluationResponse
AnswerEvaluationResponse.description: Local/deterministic feedback for a submitted multiple-choice answer (no LLM call).

role.title: Role
role.description: Speaker role ('user' or 'assistant' only; 'system' is forbidden).

content.title: Content
content.description: Bounded message text content (1 to 500 characters).

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description:
Single message in an ephemeral, browser-maintained conversation window.

Server-side role validation strictly permits only 'user' and 'assistant'
(rejecting 'system', 'developer', or 'tool' roles to prevent prompt injection).

ExplanationLanguage.description: Supported languages for option and tutor explanations.

option_explanations.title: Option Explanations

supporting_sentence.title: Supporting Sentence

verified_past_exam_examples.title: Verified Past Exam Examples
verified_past_exam_examples.description: Verified examples from past JLPT exams attached server-side from the curated source collection.
